name: Mount Pleasant / McMaster University; earlier Wonderland route number
description: The number has two unrelated eras: a seasonal Wonderland service, renumbered 60 in 2008, and a new Mount Pleasant–McMaster service introduced in 2026. The earlier service must not be joined into a continuous geography with the new route.

timeline.event: Original Wonderland Table 43 shows a seasonal service between Canada’s Wonderland, Yorkdale Subway and York Mills Subway, with separate seasonal fares. The surviving page displays July 1, 2003 service.
The Wonderland service resumes under number 60, replacing number 43, according to the contemporary April 22 service notice.

A new, unrelated route 43 appears in the effective September 5 timetable: Mount Pleasant GO to McMaster via Mississauga Road, Meadowvale, Trafalgar/407 and Dundas/407. It operates weekdays excluding holidays.

sources.title: GO Wonderland Table 43, effective June 28, 2003; displayed service for July 1
Transit Toronto, April 22, 2008: GO Transit changes May schedules and Wonderland route number

gaps: The first launch year of the earlier Wonderland service and its full earlier seasonal branch history remain unverified.
The 2003 original has only table identification; no claim is made that modern public headsign numbering existed in the same form in 2003.
Do not copy route 60A’s 2013 short branch into route 43 without an earlier original source.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
